    airline=["AE"],
    num_layovers=[1],

)

save_to_cache(key="filtered_flights", value=filtered_flights)

# Sort the filtered flights by departure time
sorted_flights = sort_results(
    results=filtered_flights,
    column="departure_time",
    ascending=True
)

# Save the sorted results to the cache for future reference
save_to_cache(key="sorted_flights", value=sorted_flights)

# Output the query summary
